_comment: Display text for js/db/Health/Diseases.json, which is regenerated by tools/health/gen_diseases.py and therefore never carries a translation. Health_DiseaseSystem._localize lays this over a private copy of the db, keyed by id; only name, desc and the symptom labels are replaced.

adenovirus.name: Adenovirus
adenovirus.desc: Sore throat, red eyes and a fever that outstays its welcome.

aether-lung.name: Aether Lung
aether-lung.desc: Breathing raw aether crystallizes the alveoli faintly aglow.

aids.name: AIDS
aids.desc: The immune system has been dismantled. Every other pathogen walks straight in.

alzheimers.name: Alzheimer's Disease
alzheimers.desc: Memory unspooling as plaques choke the mind.

amoebiasis.name: Amoebic Dysentery
amoebiasis.desc: Entamoeba eating through the gut wall.

anemia.name: Iron-Deficiency Anemia
anemia.desc: Too little iron; the blood carries too little air.

anthrax.name: Anthrax
anthrax.desc: Spores from the soil or the mail; black eschars and a fast collapse.

anxiety.name: Generalized Anxiety
anxiety.desc: Alarm that never fully switches off.

arrhythmia.name: Cardiac Arrhythmia
arrhythmia.desc: A heart that skips, races, or stutters out of time.

ascariasis.name: Roundworm
ascariasis.desc: Giant roundworms in the gut, eating first and leaving you the remainder.

aspergillosis.name: Aspergillosis
aspergillosis.desc: Mold colonizing the lungs of the vulnerable.

asphalt-cough.name: Asphalt Cough
asphalt-cough.desc: The long-haul sickness. Every cough comes up tasting of a road you have not driven yet.

asthma.name: Asthma
asthma.desc: Airways that tighten and wheeze under trigger and strain.

athletes-foot.name: Athlete's Foot
athletes-foot.desc: Tinea pedis. Itching, peeling, contagious feet.

b12-deficiency.name: B12 Deficiency
b12-deficiency.desc: Pins and needles climbing from the feet, and a memory going the other way.

babesiosis.name: Babesiosis
babesiosis.desc: A tick-borne malaria of sorts, chewing red cells in the same lazy way.

bedbugs.name: Bedbugs
bedbugs.desc: The inn's mattress had tenants. They travel in the seams of your pack.

bells-palsy.name: Bell's Palsy
bells-palsy.desc: One side of the face stopped answering overnight. Usually it comes back.

beriberi.name: Beriberi
beriberi.desc: Thiamine deficiency drowning nerves and heart.

bipolar.name: Bipolar Disorder
bipolar.desc: Tides of mania and depression on their own calendar.

black-mold.name: Black Mold Sickness
black-mold.desc: Chronic mycotoxin exposure fogging body and mind.

bloom-fungus.name: Corpse Bloom
bloom-fungus.desc: A fungus that gardens the living toward a flowering death.

botulism.name: Botulism
botulism.desc: The most potent toxin known; descending paralysis.

brain-eating-amoeba.name: Naegleriasis
brain-eating-amoeba.desc: A single amoeba went up the nose from warm fresh water and began eating the frontal lobe. Almost nobody has ever survived it.

brucellosis.name: Brucellosis
brucellosis.desc: Unpasteurised milk. A fever that comes and goes on its own tide for months.

campylobacter.name: Campylobacteriosis
campylobacter.desc: Chicken, unwashed hands, and the worst stomach cramps of your life.

candidiasis.name: Candidiasis
candidiasis.desc: Yeast overgrowth; thrush or genital infection.

celiac.name: Celiac Disease
celiac.desc: Gluten triggering an immune assault on the small bowel.

chagas.name: Chagas Disease
chagas.desc: Kissing-bug trypanosome that decades later wrecks the heart.

chickenpox.name: Chickenpox
chickenpox.desc: Varicella-zoster. Itching crops of blisters everywhere.

chigoe.name: Chigoe Flea
chigoe.desc: Burrowed into the toe and swelling to a pea. Walking is a negotiation.

chikungunya.name: Chikungunya
chikungunya.desc: Mosquito-borne. The name means the illness that bends you up, and it does.

chlamydia.name: Chlamydia
chlamydia.desc: Often silent venereal infection; a leading cause of infertility.

cholera.name: Cholera
cholera.desc: Rice-water diarrhea that can kill by dehydration in a day.

chronic-lyme.name: Late Disseminated Lyme
chronic-lyme.desc: The spirochete settled into joints and nerves and stopped answering to anything.

chrono-ague.name: Chronal Ague
chrono-ague.desc: Time stutters in the body; wounds age and heal out of order.

cirrhosis.name: Hepatic Cirrhosis
cirrhosis.desc: The liver has been replaced by scar. What it used to filter, nothing does.

cjd.name: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease
cjd.desc: Prions spongifying the brain; rapid, unstoppable dementia.

cmv.name: Cytomegalovirus
cmv.desc: Ubiquitous herpesvirus, dangerous only to the immunocompromised.

cocoon-blight.name: Cocoon Blight
cocoon-blight.desc: A metamorphic infection that half-seals the host in chrysalis.

collective-vision.name: Collective Vision
collective-vision.desc: Four hundred witnesses, one identical impossible thing, no photograph.

common-cold.name: Common Cold
common-cold.desc: Rhinovirus. Runny nose, mild but relentlessly contagious.

convent-mimicry.name: Convent Mimicry
convent-mimicry.desc: One sister meows, then the cloister does, and no prayer stops it.

copd.name: COPD
copd.desc: Emphysema and bronchitis stealing lung capacity for good.

covid.name: Novel Coronavirus
covid.desc: A pandemic respiratory virus with a stubborn viral load.

crab-lice.name: Crab Lice
crab-lice.desc: The other kind of lice, and the more embarrassing conversation.

crimean-congo.name: Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever
crimean-congo.desc: A tick bite, then bruising under skin that has not been struck.

crohns.name: Crohn's Disease
crohns.desc: Inflammation anywhere along the gut, flaring and remitting.

cryptococcosis.name: Cryptococcosis
cryptococcosis.desc: Fungal meningitis, chiefly in the immunocompromised.

cryptosporidiosis.name: Cryptosporidiosis
cryptosporidiosis.desc: Chlorine does not touch it. One swimming pool, one whole town.

dancing-plague.name: Dancing Fever
dancing-plague.desc: They dance until the feet split, and cannot say why they started.

data-rot.name: Data Rot
data-rot.desc: Corruption spreading through implanted memory and nerve-lace.

depression.name: Clinical Depression
depression.desc: A grey weight on will, energy, and joy.

diabetes-1.name: Type 1 Diabetes
diabetes-1.desc: Autoimmune loss of insulin; blood sugar unmoored.

diabetes-2.name: Type 2 Diabetes
diabetes-2.desc: Insulin resistance from a lifetime of strain.

diabetic-neuropathy.name: Diabetic Neuropathy
diabetic-neuropathy.desc: Years of unmanaged sugar have taken the nerves in the feet and the eyes with them.

diphtheria.name: Diphtheria
diphtheria.desc: A grey membrane grows across the throat until breath will not pass.

doppelganger-panic.name: Doppelganger Panic
doppelganger-panic.desc: Half the district swears a neighbour has been replaced by a very good copy.

dream-plague.name: Dream Plague
dream-plague.desc: An infection carried between sleepers, harvesting rest.

ebola.name: Ebola
ebola.desc: Hemorrhagic fever. The body unmakes itself from within.

echinococcosis.name: Hydatid Disease
echinococcosis.desc: A dog tapeworm's cyst, growing quietly in the liver for a decade. Never puncture it.

elephantiasis.name: Lymphatic Filariasis
elephantiasis.desc: Filarial worms blocking lymph until limbs swell grotesquely.

encephalitis-lethargica.name: Sleeping Sickness of the Brain
encephalitis-lethargica.desc: Sleep that deepens into statue stillness; some never surface again.

endocarditis.name: Infective Endocarditis
endocarditis.desc: Bacteria colonised a heart valve and are shedding into the blood with every beat.

epilepsy.name: Epilepsy
epilepsy.desc: Electrical storms that seize the brain without warning.

fainting-sickness.name: Fainting Sickness
fainting-sickness.desc: One faints in assembly and forty follow within the hour.

familiar-fever.name: Familiar Fever
familiar-fever.desc: Caught off somebody else's familiar. You dream its dreams and wake with its appetite.

fatal-insomnia.name: Fatal Familial Insomnia
fatal-insomnia.desc: A prion stealing sleep until the body simply stops.

fifth-disease.name: Slapped Cheek
fifth-disease.desc: Parvovirus B19. A bright red face and a week of aching joints.

fleas.name: Flea Infestation
fleas.desc: Picked up from a dog, a bed or a corpse. They bite in lines of three.

gangrene.name: Gangrene
gangrene.desc: Tissue death spreading from a wound; smells of rot.

genital-theft-panic.name: Genital-Stealing Witch Panic
genital-theft-panic.desc: Word spreads that a handshake can steal what a man was born with. The mob believes it first and checks later.

gerd.name: Chronic GERD
gerd.desc: Acid climbing the esophagus night after night.

giardiasis.name: Giardiasis
giardiasis.desc: Beaver fever. Greasy diarrhea from contaminated water.

glossolalia-wave.name: Speaking Sickness
glossolalia-wave.desc: A grammar nobody was taught runs through a congregation in one evening.

goiter.name: Iodine-Deficiency Goiter
goiter.desc: The thyroid swelling in a hunt for missing iodine.

graves.name: Graves' Disease
graves.desc: Overdriven thyroid; racing heart and bulging eyes.

gray-static.name: Gray Static
gray-static.desc: A signal-borne affliction fuzzing thought and vision to snow.

grimoire-tinnitus.name: Grimoire Tinnitus
grimoire-tinnitus.desc: Read something aloud that was meant to be read silently. It is still finishing the sentence.

guinea-worm.name: Guinea Worm
guinea-worm.desc: A metre of worm emerging from the shin, one agonising centimetre a day.

hand-foot-mouth.name: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease
hand-foot-mouth.desc: Coxsackievirus. Blisters exactly where the name says and nowhere pleasant.

hantavirus.name: Hantavirus
hantavirus.desc: Rodent-borne pulmonary syndrome. Drowning on dry land.

hashimoto.name: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis
hashimoto.desc: The thyroid slowly extinguished; cold and heavy.

hepatitis-a.name: Hepatitis A
hepatitis-a.desc: Fecal-oral liver virus. Jaundice and exhaustion.

hepatitis-b.name: Hepatitis B
hepatitis-b.desc: Bloodborne and sexual. Chronic liver inflammation.

hepatitis-c.name: Hepatitis C
hepatitis-c.desc: Silent bloodborne virus scarring the liver over decades.

herpes-simplex.name: Herpes Simplex
herpes-simplex.desc: Lifelong latent virus; periodic cold-sore or genital flares.

histoplasmosis.name: Histoplasmosis
histoplasmosis.desc: Breathed in off cave floors and bird lofts. The lungs answer in nodules.

hiv.name: HIV
hiv.desc: Retrovirus dismantling the immune system over years.

hollow-shell.name: The Hollow Shell
hollow-shell.desc: The hollowing finished. Something else is answering to your name now.

hollowing.name: The Hollowing
hollowing.desc: A slow undeath: warmth, name, and self leaching away.

hookworm.name: Hookworm
hookworm.desc: Soil-borne worm draining blood from the gut wall.

hpv.name: Human Papillomavirus
hpv.desc: Common venereal virus; some strains oncogenic.

hypertension.name: Hypertension
hypertension.desc: The silent pressure quietly straining heart and vessels.

ibs.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
ibs.desc: A gut at war with itself, cramping to its own rhythm.

influenza.name: Influenza
influenza.desc: Seasonal flu virus. Fever, aches, and a week of misery.

insomnia-chronic.name: Chronic Insomnia
insomnia-chronic.desc: Sleep withheld night after grinding night.

iron-lung-curse.name: Iron Lung Curse
iron-lung-curse.desc: Each breath rusts; the chest slowly seizes to metal.

japanese-encephalitis.name: Viral Encephalitis
japanese-encephalitis.desc: A mosquito, a paddy field, and inflammation where thought is kept.

kuru.name: Kuru
kuru.desc: The laughing death; a prion once spread by ritual cannibalism.

kwashiorkor.name: Kwashiorkor
kwashiorkor.desc: Protein starvation swelling a hollow body.

lassa.name: Lassa Fever
lassa.desc: Carried by rats, hemorrhagic in the unlucky fifth, deafening in the survivors.

laughing-pox.name: Laughing Pox
laughing-pox.desc: Pustules that itch into helpless, exhausting laughter.

laughter-epidemic.name: Laughter Epidemic
laughter-epidemic.desc: It starts in a schoolroom and closes the school; nobody finds it funny by the third week.

leeches.name: Leech Infestation
leeches.desc: Waded through the wrong water. They are painless, patient and full.

legionnaires.name: Legionnaires' Disease
legionnaires.desc: Bred in cooling towers, breathed in by everyone downwind of one.

leishmaniasis.name: Leishmaniasis
leishmaniasis.desc: Sandfly protozoan; disfiguring sores or organ disease.

leprosy.name: Leprosy
leprosy.desc: Hansen's disease numbing nerves and disfiguring slowly.

ley-necrosis.name: Ley Necrosis
ley-necrosis.desc: The rot reached the channels themselves. Magic drains out of you faster than it comes in.

ley-rot.name: Ley Rot
ley-rot.desc: Mana channels blackening and leaking; magic sours in the veins.

lice.name: Head Lice
lice.desc: Insects nesting in the hair; itchy and socially dire.

listeriosis.name: Listeriosis
listeriosis.desc: Soft cheese kept badly. It crosses barriers other bacteria respect.

liver-abscess.name: Amoebic Liver Abscess
liver-abscess.desc: The dysentery went through the gut wall and built itself a cavity in the liver.

liver-fluke.name: Liver Fluke
liver-fluke.desc: Raw river fish, and now something is living in your bile ducts.

loop-amnesia.name: Loop Amnesia
loop-amnesia.desc: You have had this disease before. You will have it again. The middle keeps going missing.

lupus.name: Lupus
lupus.desc: The wolf. Immunity turned on the body's own tissues.

lycanthropy.name: Lycanthropy
lycanthropy.desc: A bite that took. The body keeps a calendar of its own and it is lunar.

lyme.name: Lyme Disease
lyme.desc: Tick-borne; a bullseye rash then joint and nerve grief.

mad-cow.name: Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy
mad-cow.desc: A misfolded protein out of the food chain, patient for a decade, then all at once.

malaria.name: Malaria
malaria.desc: Plasmodium cycling through the blood in fevered waves.

mana-plague.name: Mana Plague
mana-plague.desc: A wildfire of corrupted mana leaping between casters.

mange.name: Sarcoptic Mange
mange.desc: Caught off a beast; the mites go deeper and the crusts go thicker than scabies.

marburg.name: Marburg Fever
marburg.desc: A filovirus out of a mine shaft. Bleeding from every soft tissue.

measles.name: Measles
measles.desc: Extraordinarily contagious. Koplik spots and a blanketing rash.

melioidosis.name: Melioidosis
melioidosis.desc: Out of wet soil after rain, abscessing anywhere it likes and relapsing for years.

meningitis.name: Bacterial Meningitis
meningitis.desc: Inflamed meninges. Stiff neck, photophobia, and speed kills.

migraine.name: Chronic Migraine
migraine.desc: Storms of headache with aura, light, and nausea.

miliary-tuberculosis.name: Miliary Tuberculosis
miliary-tuberculosis.desc: The bacillus is out of the lungs and seeded through every organ in millet-sized colonies.

mirror-sickness.name: Mirror Sickness
mirror-sickness.desc: Reflections lag, then disagree; the self doubles and frays.

monkeypox.name: Monkeypox
monkeypox.desc: Smallpox's smaller cousin, out of the forest and into the towns.

mononucleosis.name: Mononucleosis
mononucleosis.desc: The kissing disease. Epstein-Barr leaves you flattened for weeks.

ms.name: Multiple Sclerosis
ms.desc: The immune system stripping nerve insulation.

mucormycosis.name: Mucormycosis
mucormycosis.desc: A black mould with an appetite for the face of anyone whose defences have slipped.

myiasis.name: Botfly Myiasis
myiasis.desc: Something laid eggs under your skin and the lump moves when you press it.

name-theft-panic.name: Name Theft Panic
name-theft-panic.desc: People stop saying their own names aloud; something is collecting them.

narcolepsy.name: Narcolepsy
narcolepsy.desc: Sleep intruding on waking life without permission.

night-blindness.name: Vitamin A Deficiency
night-blindness.desc: The world goes out at dusk, then the cornea starts to soften.

nipah.name: Nipah Encephalitis
nipah.desc: Bat-borne and brain-hungry; survivors rarely come back whole.

norovirus.name: Norovirus
norovirus.desc: Winter vomiting bug. Explosive and absurdly contagious.

null-syndrome.name: Null Syndrome
null-syndrome.desc: The self overwritten with blanks; identity checksum fails.

numbers-compulsion.name: Number Station Compulsion
numbers-compulsion.desc: Listeners start copying the broadcast down, then reading it out to each other.

ocd.name: OCD
ocd.desc: Intrusive thoughts answered by rituals that never satisfy.

packet-fever.name: Packet Fever
packet-fever.desc: Caught off a terminal. Your sense of sequence arrives out of order and retries.

parkinsons.name: Parkinson's Disease
parkinsons.desc: Dopamine fading; tremor, rigidity, and a slowing gait.

pellagra.name: Pellagra
pellagra.desc: Niacin lack: the four D's, dermatitis to dementia to death.

pelvic-inflammatory.name: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease
pelvic-inflammatory.desc: An untreated infection climbed, scarred what it found and settled in to stay.

petro-lung.name: Petro Lung
petro-lung.desc: Crude in the alveoli that will not come up and will not stop being warm.

phantom-gasser.name: Phantom Gasser Panic
phantom-gasser.desc: A prowler with a sweet-smelling spray that the police never once find.

phantom-infestation.name: Phantom Infestation
phantom-infestation.desc: Everyone in the plant feels the bug bite. No entomologist ever finds it.

pinworm.name: Pinworm
pinworm.desc: A childhood parasite with no dignity and enormous persistence.

plague.name: Bubonic Plague
plague.desc: The Black Death. Buboes, fever, and blackened extremities.

polio.name: Poliomyelitis
polio.desc: Attacks motor neurons; can leave permanent paralysis.

possession.name: Possession
possession.desc: There are two of you in there and only one of you is keeping track of the days.

post-viral-syndrome.name: Post-Viral Syndrome
post-viral-syndrome.desc: The virus is long gone. Whatever it did to you stayed.

psoriasis.name: Psoriasis
psoriasis.desc: Skin cells racing to the surface in silvery plaques.

ptsd.name: PTSD
ptsd.desc: The past ambushing the present in flashes.

q-fever.name: Q Fever
q-fever.desc: Breathed in off a barn floor. Half of those who catch it never notice.

rabies.name: Rabies
rabies.desc: Once symptomatic, near-universally fatal. Hydrophobia and fury.

recursion-sickness.name: Recursion Sickness
recursion-sickness.desc: Every thought calls itself once more before finishing. The stack does not unwind.

rheumatic-fever.name: Rheumatic Fever
rheumatic-fever.desc: An untreated throat infection taught the body to attack its own heart valves.

rheumatoid.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
rheumatoid.desc: Immune-driven joint destruction, symmetric and stiff.

rickets.name: Rickets
rickets.desc: Vitamin D starvation softening and bowing the bones.

ringworm.name: Ringworm
ringworm.desc: Dermatophyte fungus in expanding itchy rings.

river-blindness.name: River Blindness
river-blindness.desc: Onchocerca microfilariae migrating to the eyes.

rubella.name: Rubella
rubella.desc: German measles. Mild in adults, dangerous in pregnancy.

saints-fire.name: Saint's Fire
saints-fire.desc: Ergotism reborn: burning limbs, gangrene, and holy visions.

salmonellosis.name: Salmonellosis
salmonellosis.desc: Undercooked egg. Two days of regret and a week of caution.

sars.name: Atypical Pneumonia
sars.desc: A new pneumonia that jumps wards faster than the paperwork.

satanic-panic.name: Satanic Panic
satanic-panic.desc: The rumour arrives fully formed with names attached, and the names get burned.

scabies.name: Scabies
scabies.desc: Mites burrowing under the skin; maddening night itch.

scarlet-fever.name: Scarlet Fever
scarlet-fever.desc: Strep with a sandpaper rash and strawberry tongue.

schistosomiasis.name: Schistosomiasis
schistosomiasis.desc: Freshwater flukes lodging in blood vessels for years.

schizophrenia.name: Schizophrenia
schizophrenia.desc: Perception and reality slipping their moorings.

scrapie.name: Scrapie Contact
scrapie.desc: The shepherd's disease. Ewes rub themselves raw on the fence, and then so do you.

scurvy.name: Scurvy
scurvy.desc: Vitamin C gone; collagen fails and old wounds reopen.

sepsis.name: Sepsis
sepsis.desc: The body's response to infection turning on itself.

shigellosis.name: Shigellosis
shigellosis.desc: Ten organisms are enough. Dysentery with blood in it.

shingles.name: Shingles
shingles.desc: Reactivated varicella tracing a nerve in searing pain.

sigil-blight.name: Sigil Blight
sigil-blight.desc: Written wards go soft near you and every seal you touch reads slightly wrong afterwards.

sleeping-sickness.name: African Sleeping Sickness
sleeping-sickness.desc: Tsetse trypanosome invading the brain; sleep inverts and fails.

sleepwalk-pilgrimage.name: Sleepwalking Pilgrimage
sleepwalk-pilgrimage.desc: The town wakes on the road out of town, all facing the same way.

smallpox.name: Smallpox
smallpox.desc: Eradicated in life, resurgent in nightmares. Pustular and deadly.

soul-sickness.name: Soul Sickness
soul-sickness.desc: Nothing is wrong with the body. Something is wrong at the level the body is an expression of, and it is spreading by sympathy.

spanish-flu.name: Great Influenza
spanish-flu.desc: The flu that killed the young and healthy first. Drowning from the inside.

sporotrichosis.name: Sporotrichosis
sporotrichosis.desc: The rose gardener's disease, climbing the arm one nodule per lymph node.

star-madness.name: Star Madness
star-madness.desc: Gazing too long into deep sky invites a geometry that maddens.

static-communion.name: Static Communion
static-communion.desc: The gray static resolved into a signal, and the signal is using you as an aerial.

stone-flesh.name: Stone Flesh
stone-flesh.desc: Skin hardening toward statue; slow, heavy, and irreversible.

syphilis.name: Syphilis
syphilis.desc: The great imitator; untreated it climbs to the brain.

tapeworm.name: Tapeworm
tapeworm.desc: A segmented guest in the gut, quietly taking your meals.

tarantism.name: Tarantism
tarantism.desc: A spider nobody saw; only music and dancing are said to draw the venom out.

tertiary-syphilis.name: Tertiary Syphilis
tertiary-syphilis.desc: Decades late, the spirochete comes back for the aorta and the mind.

tetanus.name: Tetanus
tetanus.desc: Lockjaw. Neurotoxin locking every muscle rigid.

the-quiet.name: The Quiet
the-quiet.desc: Sound keeps arriving. Meaning has stopped. It spreads to whoever you try to explain it to.

ticks.name: Tick Infestation
ticks.desc: Buried head-first and swelling. What they carry is worse than what they take.

tower-vertigo.name: Tower Vertigo
tower-vertigo.desc: Up has stopped being a direction and started being a place, and it is pulling.

toxoplasmosis.name: Toxoplasmosis
toxoplasmosis.desc: Cat-borne protozoan; may nudge behavior and risk-taking.

trachoma.name: Trachoma
trachoma.desc: Repeated infection scars the lid until the lashes turn inward on the eye.

trichinosis.name: Trichinosis
trichinosis.desc: Undercooked pork. The larvae encyst in muscle, including the ones you breathe with.

tuberculosis.name: Tuberculosis
tuberculosis.desc: Consumption. A slow, coughing wasting of the lungs.

typhoid.name: Typhoid Fever
typhoid.desc: Salmonella typhi. Sustained fever and rose spots.

typhus.name: Epidemic Typhus
typhus.desc: Louse-borne camp fever: rash, stupor, and the smell of crowded rooms.

ulcer.name: Peptic Ulcer
ulcer.desc: H. pylori and acid burning a hole in the stomach lining.

void-touch.name: Void Touch
void-touch.desc: Contact with the outer dark; a cold that eats from inside.

wendigo-hunger.name: Wendigo Hunger
wendigo-hunger.desc: A gnawing that ordinary food cannot touch, and craves worse.

whipworm.name: Whipworm
whipworm.desc: Threaded into the colon wall, bleeding you a little at a time for years.

whisper-fever.name: Whisper Fever
whisper-fever.desc: A fever whose delirium speaks in others' voices.

whooping-cough.name: Whooping Cough
whooping-cough.desc: Pertussis. Paroxysmal coughing fits ending in a whoop.

windscreen-pitting.name: Windscreen Pitting Delusion
windscreen-pitting.desc: The whole city inspects its windscreens and finds damage that was always there.

zika.name: Zika Virus
zika.desc: Usually mild, dangerous in pregnancy. Also sexually transmissible.

broken-arm.name: Broken Arm
broken-arm.desc: A fractured arm splinted and slung; strength halved on that side.

broken-leg.name: Broken Leg
broken-leg.desc: A fractured leg in a cast; every step is negotiated.

broken-rib.name: Broken Rib
broken-rib.desc: Cracked ribs make breath and swing a wince.

concussion.name: Concussion
concussion.desc: A rung skull; thought comes slow and light stings.

sprained-ankle.name: Sprained Ankle
sprained-ankle.desc: Torn ligaments; the ankle protests weight.

dislocated-shoulder.name: Dislocated Shoulder
dislocated-shoulder.desc: Reset but tender; the arm holds nothing heavy yet.

deep-laceration.name: Deep Laceration
deep-laceration.desc: A stitched wound that reopens if pushed too hard.

severe-burns.name: Severe Burns
severe-burns.desc: Healing burns tighten skin and blunt every nerve.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.desc: Frozen tissue, blackened at the tips, aching in the cold.

whiplash.name: Whiplash
whiplash.desc: A wrenched neck locking the head in careful poses.

spinal-injury.name: Spinal Injury
spinal-injury.desc: Damage along the spine dulling strength and speed.

amputation.name: Amputation
amputation.desc: A limb lost; balance and reach permanently changed.

cataract.name: Cataract
cataract.desc: A clouding lens dimming the world to fog.

hearing-loss.name: Hearing Loss
hearing-loss.desc: A silence closing in; the world loses its warnings.

chronic-back-pain.name: Chronic Back Pain
chronic-back-pain.desc: An old ache that colors every lift and stride.

arthritis.name: Osteoarthritis
arthritis.desc: Worn joints grinding stiff, worse in the cold.

osteoporosis.name: Osteoporosis
osteoporosis.desc: Brittle bones a hard fall could shatter.

kidney-stones.name: Kidney Stones
kidney-stones.desc: A grain of agony passing on its own cruel schedule.

appendicitis.name: Appendicitis
appendicitis.desc: An inflamed appendix; a surgical clock ticking.

hernia.name: Hernia
hernia.desc: A bulge that turns lifting into a gamble.

gout.name: Gout
